input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 addresses termination only one way: Sparkling must cease use and return or destroy Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes. There is no obligation on Garman to provide any wind-down or transition assistance, and no obligation to return Sparkling's data (which Garman handles under the Section 4 data conversion work) or to certify deletion. Section 8 return-of-Confidential-Information applies only if the reject option is exercised, and Section 18 survival adds nothing on exit assistance; searches for "transition" and "return" confirm no equivalent clause elsewhere. The agreement therefore fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day data export), so we insert a new Section 17(d) at the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, certified deletion thereafter), flagging the 90-day fallback in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Sparkling data return/deletion obligations on termination in Section 17
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 17 only requires Sparkling to return Garman's Software and Codes on termination; nothing obliges Garman to help us wind down or to give back our own data. We have added a new Section 17(d) providing up to six months of transition assistance at Garman's then-current rates, return of Sparkling's data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance with the same 30-day data export.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (i) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) calendar days of Sparkling's request, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data in Garman's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
